# wcgrep

Count matches of a pattern in files.

```
wcgrep PATTERN FILE...
```

## Environment

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `WCGREP_CONFIG_DIR` | Configuration directory. Default `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/wcgrep`. |
| `WCGREP_COLOR` | `always`, `never` or `auto` (default). |
| `NO_COLOR` | Disable color ([no-color.org](https://no-color.org)). |
